title: About
text: Hi! My name is Ella Cave, I am a junior student at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln studying Sports Media Communications and Broadcasting, minoring in Hospitality. I am interested in a career in sports media that includes either broadcasting or digital media. While being at UNL I have been able to write game stories, cover sporting events, and much more. I also have experience in social media through working with Hurrdat Sports as a Social Media Intern. I like to share stories about athletes, teams, and people behind just sports. Outside of school I enjoy hanging out with friends and family, being involved in Alpha Omicron Pi, and going to sports events.
